description: This file contains unit tests for the PurgeNamespaceReason class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.common package. It verifies behaviors such as immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and relevance checks.

classes.name: PurgeNamespaceReasonTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the PurgeNamespaceReason class, testing JSON serialization, equality, immutability, and logic correctness.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test constants including the PURGE_NAMESPACE type, a known namespace string, and its JSON representation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test instance before each test by creating a PurgeNamespaceReason with the known namespace.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies the immutability of the PurgeNamespaceReason class.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations in PurgeNamespaceReason.

methods.name: getTypeReturnsPurgeNamespace
methods.description: Checks that the getType method returns the correct type.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithEmptyNamespace
methods.description: Ensures that creating a PurgeNamespaceReason with an empty namespace throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: toJsonWithoutSchemaVersionAndPredicateReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the JSON output matches the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: toJsonWithHiddenFieldsOnlyReturnsEmptyJsonObject
methods.description: Verifies that calling toJson with hidden fields returns an empty JSON object.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Tests that a JSON representation can be deserialized back into the correct PurgeNamespaceReason instance.

methods.name: fromJsonWithoutDetailsCausesException
methods.description: Ensures that JSON missing required fields throws a JsonMissingFieldException.

methods.name: isRelevantForIsTrueIfNamespaceIsEqual
methods.description: Checks that isRelevantFor returns true when the namespace matches.

methods.name: isRelevantForIsFalseIfNamespaceIsNotEqual
methods.description: Checks that isRelevantFor returns false when the namespace does not match.

methods.name: toStringContainsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toString method output contains class name and namespace.
